task.title: Run the Level 1 CIS workflow
task.shortdesc: Create, inspect, compare, export, and independently verify a representative Level 1 CIS profile.

prereq.p: Use fixture cis-workflow-level-1-esr-fixture: Firefox ESR 140.12, layer cis-l1.esr-140.12, starter preset basic_corporate, and comparison profile blank-esr-140.12.

context.p: The workflow is deterministic because it follows the same route order every time: Library, Guided Editor, All Settings, Profile Comparison, Export, and external verification. Recommendation rows provide the path to affected Firefox policy topics through their generated mapping tables.

step.cmd: Create a profile from the Library, choose Firefox ESR 140.12, apply the Basic corporate starter preset, and then apply the Level 1 CIS layer.

info.p: Expected result: the profile shows cis-l1.esr-140.12 as the active CIS layer and keeps starter-preset source attribution visible.

step.cmd: Open Guided Editor and review the CIS-related summary, schema channel, profile identity, and the major security/privacy groups affected by the Level 1 layer.

info.p: Expected result: Guided Editor presents the Level 1 profile as a reviewable configuration, not as a proof of CIS compliance.

step.cmd: Open All Settings, filter by CIS/source attribution, inspect configured rows, and follow each recommendation row to the generated mapping table and affected Firefox policy topic.

info.p: Expected result: the reviewer can trace values through baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw source states.

step.cmd: Resolve attention items and manual-review rows by recording an owner and decision for update governance, proxy routing, evidence-retention, unsupported mapping research, deprecated targets, or local deployment requirements.

info.note: Do not close a manual-review item by claiming compliance; record external evidence when the decision depends on runtime, network, operating-system, or audit checks outside BPM.

step.cmd: Compare the Level 1 profile with the blank ESR fixture profile and inspect equal, changed, missing-left, and missing-right rows.

info.p: Expected result: comparison confirms the Level 1 layer introduced the expected configured policy and preference differences.

step.cmd: Validate the profile, export policies.json, and perform the approved independent deployment verification outside BPM.

info.p: Expected result: the exported document, validation result, comparison note, and external verification record can be reviewed together.

result.p: The representative Level 1 hardened profile is created, inspected in Guided and All Settings, compared, exported, and independently verified with traceable evidence.

postreq.p: If any recommendation row lacks a generated mapping table, affected Firefox policy topic path, export path, or external verification record, keep the workflow open.
